title: Author-designed study
description: A rectangular study with one desk, a west door and an east window on the north wall.
style: Ink line art with muted warm colors.
lighting: Daylight enters the east window from camera right.
invariants: Exactly one west door and one east window; never mirror their arrangement.
Desk remains centered unless the panel explicitly moves it.
Daylight direction stays east to west.
assumptions: This demo is an authored set, not reconstructed from a photograph.
Boxes mark landmarks; they are not complete walls or furniture meshes.
